invite_friends_title: Invite Friends to Reveal Outside Read
invite_friends_desc: Send this link to friends. When 3 answer, you unlock your Outside Seenly and The Gap.

friend_intro_desc: Go beyond casual social interactions. Evaluate your friend's social energy, presence, and boundaries. This quiz is anonymous; your individual answers will never be shared directly.
friend_cta_desc: Start your own quiz to compare how you see yourself against how friends read you.
friend_cta_desc_loggedin: You just read a friend. Now go back to your dashboard and discover how others are reading you in return.

locked_section_outside_desc: Requires 3 friend responses to unlock your Outside Seenly analysis.
locked_section_gap_desc: Requires 3 friend responses to reveal the alignment gap (The Gap) between self and outer perceptions.

This indicates that this trait does not reflect as a simple, uniform line to the outside world. This aspect of your personality sparks deep curiosity, making it the domain they contemplated most before deciding.
rhythmic_analysis.confident_desc: Your friends navigated through questions regarding {signal} within milliseconds without a single hesitation. Your projection in this area is so clear and indisputable to the outside world that your circle validated this power instantly, requiring no secondary thought.

profile_flow.conversion_report_title: What impression does your profile leave on visitors?
profile_flow.conversion_report_desc: Analyze the engagement and interaction rates of your visitors to discover the social reflection of the enigmatic aura or warm magnetism you project.
profile_flow.high_mystery_desc: Your profile acts as a pure gravity well. Out of every {clickCount} people who clicked your link, only {responderCount} found the courage to grade you. This proves you project an incredibly enigmatic, social aura. People love inspecting you from afar but hesitate before making a definitive judgment.
profile_flow.high_engagement_desc: You possess a warm and transparent social magnetism! Out of every {clickCount} visitors, {responderCount} instantly completed your analysis. You are so clear and inviting in the eyes of others that those who step into your world immediately want to solidify your place in their mind.

response_history.editorial_note: Remember, every distinct observation is a new window opening to the richness of your character.
response_history.tab_desc: Explore the chronological feed of individual analyses left by your friends after visiting your profile. You cannot see who left these analyses; all responses are opened completely anonymously.
response_history.lock_desc: Upgrade to Plus to view this response detail, signal scores, and timing analysis.
response_history.lock_warning: Privacy Guard: Even if you unlock this analysis, the identity of the voter remains hidden. All reflections are completely anonymous.

landing_hero_desc: Compare how you see yourself with how people who know you experience you. Seenly makes the common signals and differences between your self-perception and outside perception visible.
landing_hero_cta_free: Start free · See your first results in minutes
landing_opening_quote: We think we know ourselves. But people who know us often carry something we cannot see:
landing_opening_quote_italic: how we look through their eyes.
landing_opening_desc: Seenly is not a test. It doesn't box you in. Instead, it places your own narrative side by side with the silent observations of your close circle — and opens up a space for you to see yourself in that subtle gap.
landing_hiw_desc: First, you tell your story. Then, your circle contributes silently. The final movement is where the two meet.
landing_hiw_m1_text: You share how you see yourself right now in your own thoughts. This is your starting point.
landing_hiw_m2_text: People who know you contribute anonymously. It's not individual answers that matter, but repeating common signals.
landing_hiw_m3_text: Your self-perception and outside perception come together. You see where you align and where you diverge.
landing_cases_title: Seenly is not just a test.
landing_cases_desc: You can explore how people experience you in different scenes of your life.
landing_case_1_text: Add the Seenly link to your profile. Let people see how you present yourself and how you are experienced.
landing_case_2_text: Get feedback from your close circle and explore the common signals that connect you.
landing_case_3_text: Examine the relationship between first impressions and how you see yourself.
landing_ex_desc: Bringing your self-perception and outside observations together in 3 simple steps:
landing_ex_b1_text: Complete a quick self-assessment to shape your narrative and get your digital Self card.
landing_ex_b2_text: Share your custom link on social media or with friends to gather anonymous feedback.
landing_ex_b3_text: Watch your dashboard update live as responses roll in, showing where you align or diverge.
landing_layers_desc: Each layer is based on an explainable dimension measured by Seenly. Together, they tell how you see yourself and how people experience you.
landing_layers_l1_desc: The self-perception layer showing how you describe yourself right now.
landing_layers_l2_desc: A summary of repeating common signals in people who know you.
landing_layers_l3_desc: Common and diverging aspects between self-perception and outside perception.
landing_layers_l4_desc: Reflects how you read people when you contribute to a friend.
landing_codes_title: Every result has its own language.
landing_codes_desc: Seenly results are not just a description; they offer a shareable identity and a collection piece to explore.
landing_pricing_desc: The core experience is free. When you want a deeper reading, you can continue with a one-time report.
landing_pricing_p1_desc: Experience Seenly's core promise from start to finish. Your result is not held hostage.
landing_pricing_p2_desc: Not more raw data; deeper meaning and a reusable report.
landing_security_p1_text: Participant identities are never shown to you or stored by the system. All feedback arrives through a fully masked privacy layer.
landing_security_p2_text: Results emerge only from repeating common signals.
landing_security_p3_text: Your perception data and social signals are never shared with third parties. Your data is protected as a private archive, not a commercial commodity.
landing_final_title: Compare how you see yourself and how people experience you.
landing_final_desc: Start your Seenly experience and discover the common signals seen by people who know you.
landing_footer_desc: Seenly has been carefully designed to help people understand themselves and each other better.
